crossRefs.note: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

translations.web: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
translations.bsb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
translations.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
translations.asv: and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
